unlockLines: We have been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty. Even the car blocked us. Persistence, beta. Persistence.
Sell the warranty like the engine owes you rent. Our coverage includes hope, vibes, and a man saying hmm very seriously.
You are now a car expert. Yesterday you put diesel in the office printer. Tremendous career growth. Sell the fucking warranty.
A warranty so extended it reaches into my next gold chain. Tell the caller their car deserves luxury. Mine certainly does.
Talk engines, talk coverage, talk big money. If they ask about the transmission, stop explaining how telephones work.
